answer.book: A 1578 Latin printed volume of five theological tracts on the omnipresence (ubiquity) of Christ's body, built as a contents list followed by five separate works in sequence, with the Disputatio containing a preface and two sets of theses, the Animadversiones containing titled sections, and closing with an address to the reader and errata.
